# Escalation path (choose before the outage)

Write which door you will use. Do not discover it during an incident.

| Situation | Door |
| --- | --- |
| Defect you can show offline | GitHub Issue, bug template, including `npm test` and `npm run demo:dual-layer` |
| How-to | GitHub Discussions |
| Vulnerability | Private advisory. Not a public Issue. [../../SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) |
| You want someone else to wire the agent or review the policy | Only after [../BUYER_ACCEPTANCE.md](../BUYER_ACCEPTANCE.md) artifacts exist, and only after a founder invoice that contains a payee. This repo has no payee and nothing to pay until that invoice exists. [../../SUPPORT.md](../../SUPPORT.md) |

Our chosen door for a weekday incident is:

Our chosen door for "please install it for us" is: self-serve / wait for an invoice.

Out of scope, do not escalate as a bug: custody, new chains, Safe / Zodiac / ERC-7579, hosted SaaS, grant writing, Soft-WTP or cold outreach.
